name: @flowforge/ui-cordis
description: FlowForge Cordis dynamic-plugin definition/run/action card presentation logic and the frame-wide plugin inventory panel model (A8/D50): injectable-seam port of the dsh `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ui-cordis` client half. Extracts the testable, framework-free presentation logic (card models, status derivation, inventory observable with single-flight reads, the run-card supersession index, panel grouping/selection, and the run-card reading state) plus a pure-logic port of the localizable copy. React/DOM rendering glue and first-party UI primitives are intentionally not ported. Zero `@deepseek-ai/*` / `@cat-cafe/*` / `@clowder-ai/*` references and no cordis Service/Context feathers: every originally-dsh dependency is expressed as a package-local seam (`HostObservable`, `ToolCallViewModelBlock`, and the wire vocabulary re-exported from `@flowforge/cordis-client-runner`).
